entries.262840c84ab7bfd7: A non-ferrous metals manufacturer that makes and sells titanium metal such as titanium sponge and high-performance materials such as high-purity titanium.
entries.369001f0d824fa60: Customers, including those in semiconductor-related fields
entries.7991f11dfe4942b2: Titanium metal, the company's main product. Its main export application is said to be high-quality aircraft use, and titanium production and titanium melting facilities are located at the Head Office and Amagasaki Plant and at the Kishiwada Works.
entries.7aed54ee93439d1a: The company manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, powdered titanium and TILOP®, a spherical titanium powder. High-purity titanium is also sold for use as sputtering targets in semiconductor applications.
entries.8cd17e9c4ea1aaba: Titanium metal, the company's main product. Most products for the domestic market are used for general industrial applications, such as electrolysis plants and plate-type heat exchangers.
entries.cdcd605608392050: The company manufactures and sells titanium tetrachloride, aqueous titanium tetrachloride solution and SiO. From the current fiscal year, titanium tetrachloride and aqueous titanium tetrachloride solution are classified as main products of the High-Performance Materials Business rather than the Titanium Business. Research and development aimed at commercialization is under way for SiO as a negative electrode material for lithium secondary batteries.
entries.de3a2de233a00da5: This business manufactures and sells sponge titanium and titanium ingots as its main products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40,444 million.
entries.e1742a1a143dc735: Customers, including those for civil aircraft
entries.e4f1009dbeef49cb: This business manufactures and sells high-purity titanium, SiO, TILOP® (spherical titanium powder), powdered titanium, titanium tetrachloride and aqueous titanium tetrachloride solution as its main products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,507 million.
entries.f47490dff8e139bd: Major customers such as Sumisho Metalex Corporation and Shinko Shoji Co., Ltd.
